text: {"sql": "SELECT mts.ts, mts.machine_id, mts.failure, mts.heat_dissipation_failure, mts.overstrain_failure, mts.air_temp_k, mts.process_temp_k, mts.rpm, mts.torque_nm FROM sf_plant.machine_telemetry mts JOIN sf_plant.machines m ON mts.machine_id = m.machine_id WHERE m.station_id = 'F10' AND (mts.failure = 1 OR mts.heat_dissipation_failure = 1 OR mts.overstrain_failure = 1) ORDER BY mts.ts DESC", "columns": ["ts", "machine_id", "failure", "heat_dissipation_failure", "overstrain_failure", "air_temp_k", "process_temp_k", "rpm", "torque_nm"], "purpose": "Identify machine telemetry readings with any failure flag at F10 stations to diagnose machine-driven stops."}

data.sql: SELECT mts.ts, mts.machine_id, mts.failure, mts.heat_dissipation_failure, mts.overstrain_failure, mts.air_temp_k, mts.process_temp_k, mts.rpm, mts.torque_nm FROM sf_plant.machine_telemetry mts JOIN sf_plant.machines m ON mts.machine_id = m.machine_id WHERE m.station_id = 'F10' AND (mts.failure = 1 OR mts.heat_dissipation_failure = 1 OR mts.overstrain_failure = 1) ORDER BY mts.ts DESC
data.purpose: Identify machine telemetry readings with any failure flag at F10 stations to diagnose machine-driven stops.
